questions.question: In his letter to the believers in Philippi, what did Paul ask them to be to make his joy complete?

answers.text: Generous with their money and time

questions.question: Paul wrote that Christ Jesus did not grasp at equality with God. What did Jesus do instead?

answers.text: Emptied Himself and took a servant's form
Took a throne and ruled the earth

questions.question: Because Jesus humbled Himself all the way to death, what did God do for Him, according to Paul?

answers.text: Exalted Him to the highest place
Kept Him hidden from the world
Sent Him back to serve again

questions.question: What did Paul say every tongue should confess, to the glory of God the Father?

answers.text: That God the Father is holy
